title: Abhayagiri Vihāra
scope: The restored northern Abhayagiri stupa, cardinal entrance shrines and stone terrace in Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka.
limitations: The standing main stupa and its immediate stone enclosure are covered. The outer archaeological complex and museum are outside this model.
Individual carved figures and local brick erosion are approximated. The spire follows the restored overall height published in 2015.
